text:
maria: FYI onboarding orion-v3 weights landed in s3. Seems kernel selection is tripping on CUDA/Triton mismatch across our nodes. Need quick check before dedicated deploy.

devon: where are the weights? path?

maria: s3://redwood-models/orion-v3/2026-03-16/
Also tokenizer is nonstandard — vocab.json only (no merges), need to set `tokenizer_type=json_vocab` in model config or the tokenizer will split emojis weirdly.

tony: is Triton required for this model or can it run in our runtime?

sasha: Triton optional. Model runs in runtime but kernel selection matters. Packets from CI show cuda11.8 nodes pick older kernels; prod prefers cuda12.2 images. If we force compile for 11.8 we'll need a container rebuild.

ci-bot: build #782 failed on test-inference-orion-v3: /usr/local/cuda/lib64/libcublas.so.11: undefined symbol: cublasLtMatmul

devon: that looks like cuBLAS version mismatch — compiled against 12 libs but running 11.

runtime-ops: quick probe — nodes with driver 525 show this. Options: (1) rebuild with CUDA11.8 target, (2) use compatibility symlink (risky), (3) route requests to cuda12 pool. Prefer (1) or (3).

maria: Can we route to cuda12 pool until rebuild? We have capacity on staging but not prod.

sasha: yes can route, but latency impact + no KV cache primed. I'd rather queue a rebuild. Tony, can you handle container rebuild with `./rebuild_container.sh --cuda 11.8 --tag orionv3-cuda11-20260316`?

tony: I can. I'll kick it off after lunch. Will set CMake flag `-DUSE_LEGACY_KERNEL=ON` and update Dockerfile base to `nvidia/cuda:11.8-cudnn8-runtime-ubuntu22.04`.

ryan: heads up — if we enable USE_LEGACY_KERNEL we might lose some fused ops perf. Add perf smoke tests to the CI job.

tony: good point, adding `smoke_perf` stage.

devon: tokenizer quirk — when I ran local tests emojis split into multiple tokens, so downstream scoring drops. Maria, can you add a tokenization test to the eval set?

maria: adding a few edgecase prompts now. Will push to eval harness and tag you.

runtime-ops: action items: tony rebuild container (ETA 3h), sasha add routing rule if needed, maria push tokenizer tests, ryan add perf smoke. We'll monitor CI.

ci-bot: build #783 started (rebuild initiated by tony).

maria: thanks all :thumbsup: I'll post results here.
